a0534843fd.q: Who built the city of Wasit in Iraq?
a0534843fd.e: Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf built Wasit between Kufa and Basra.

6904198035.q: In which year did the Battle of al-Harra take place in Madinah?
6904198035.e: The Battle of al-Harra was in Dhu al-Hijjah 63 AH, in the time of Yazid ibn Muʿawiya.

019c5ae9fd.q: Which Abbasid caliph built the city of Baghdad?

60e00f28a5.q: Abu Jaʿfar al-Mansur said, “The caliphs are four.” Whom did he name?
c: Abu Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthman and ʿAli
Abu Bakr, ʿUmar, Muʿawiya and ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz
Abu Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿAli and ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz
60e00f28a5.e: Al-Mansur named the four caliphs: Abu Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthman and ʿAli ﵃.

d94f8398d1.q: Who was the first to strike dinars in Egypt?
d94f8398d1.e: ʿAbd al-ʿAziz ibn Marwan, governor of Egypt, was the first to strike dinars there.

6d40d20e4b.q: Which caliph began building the dome over the Rock in Jerusalem?
6d40d20e4b.e: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwan began building the Dome of the Rock.

1b187d416c.q: When Saladin liberated Jerusalem, whom did he appoint to give the sermon that day?
1b187d416c.e: Saladin ordered Judge Muhyi al-Din ibn al-Zaki to give the first Friday sermon in Jerusalem.

81e8afef4f.q: Who pushed Caliph al-Wathiq to be harsh in the trial over the claim that the Qurʾan is created?
81e8afef4f.e: Ibn Abi Duʾad had great influence over al-Wathiq and pushed him to be harsh in the trial (the Mihna).

960a579405.q: On which river did Marwan ibn Muhammad, the last Umayyad caliph, camp when he marched against the Abbasid armies?
960a579405.e: Marwan ibn Muhammad camped on the Zab river near Mosul, and the battle was fought there.

6f77de5c10.q: What was the name of Imam Abu Hanifa?
6f77de5c10.e: Imam Abu Hanifa's name was al-Nuʿman ibn Thabit.

beb01404b8.q: Who became caliph after ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz?
beb01404b8.e: Yazid ibn ʿAbd al-Malik received the pledge in 101 AH after ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz, as his brother Sulayman had appointed.

1f41ab8247.q: Which commander established the Abbasid state?
1f41ab8247.e: Abu Muslim al-Khurasani led the Abbasid call in Khurasan until their state was established.

afd3e7cddf.q: Which commander conquered the lands of North Africa in Umayyad times?
afd3e7cddf.e: Musa ibn Nusayr conquered the Maghrib under the Umayyads.

55ad185af9.q: What title did Harun al-Rashid give his son Muhammad when he made him heir?
55ad185af9.e: Al-Rashid named his son Muhammad (son of Zubayda) al-Amin and made him heir at the age of five.

558de02df0.q: Who took Baghdad and killed most of its people and the caliph in 656 AH?
558de02df0.e: The Tatars overran Baghdad in 656 AH, killed the caliph, and Abbasid rule there came to an end.

941b2aea33.q: In which year did the Tatars take Baghdad and end Abbasid rule there?
941b2aea33.e: Baghdad fell to the Tatars in 656 AH.

b26235505f.q: In which year did the Franks (Crusaders) take Jerusalem?
b26235505f.e: The Crusaders took Jerusalem in Shaʿban 492 AH.

40bcb360d5.q: Which battle opened the way to the liberation of Jerusalem in 583 AH?
40bcb360d5.e: Hattin was in 583 AH, and after it Saladin liberated Jerusalem.

bcba91c2df.q: Who defeated the Tatars at the Battle of ʿAyn Jalut?
bcba91c2df.e: Al-Malik al-Muzaffar Qutuz defeated the Tatars at ʿAyn Jalut.

2118160fdf.q: In which year did the caliphate of ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz begin?
2118160fdf.e: The caliphate of ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz began in 99 AH.

2813c0c27c.q: Who built the city of Cairo for the Fatimid al-Muʿizz?
2813c0c27c.e: Jawhar the commander built Cairo for the Fatimid al-Muʿizz.

f40a0464c0.q: Which three sons did Harun al-Rashid name as his heirs?
f40a0464c0.e: Al-Rashid named as heirs his sons al-Amin, then al-Maʾmun, then al-Qasim.

d8b001b383.q: Who carried the Black Stone away from the Kaʿba to their own land?
d8b001b383.e: The Qarmatians took the Black Stone to their land and attacked the pilgrims.

625dd23331.q: In which year was the Black Stone returned after the Qarmatians took it?
625dd23331.e: The Black Stone stayed with the Qarmatians until they returned it in 339 AH.

150ec7c44e.q: Which king of the Veiled Ones (al-Mulaththamun) ruled after Abu Bakr ibn ʿUmar and grew powerful in the Maghrib?
150ec7c44e.e: Yusuf ibn Tashfin ruled after Abu Bakr ibn ʿUmar, and the Veiled Ones grew strong in the Maghrib.

15a21e14d4.q: In which year did Imam al-Shafiʿi die?

28cf1bf7d1.q: In which year did Imam Malik ibn Anas die?

37e64a790e.q: In the hadith “Soon people will ride camels hard seeking knowledge and find no one more learned than the scholar of Madinah,” who did Ibn ʿUyayna say that scholar was?
37e64a790e.e: It is reported from Sufyan ibn ʿUyayna that the scholar of Madinah in the hadith is Malik ibn Anas.

4b94212487.q: Who liberated Jerusalem after the year 580 AH?
4b94212487.e: Saladin is the one who liberated Jerusalem from the Crusaders.

eaf0541ba4.q: “The caliphate after me is thirty years”: the thirty were completed when al-Hasan ﵁ handed it to Muʿawiya. In which year did he step down?
eaf0541ba4.e: Al-Hasan ﵁ stepped down from the caliphate in Rabiʿ al-Awwal 41 AH, completing thirty years after the death of the Prophet ﷺ.

6bda1aa840.q: Whom did Sulayman ibn ʿAbd al-Malik send to attack Constantinople in 98 AH?
c: His brother Maslama ibn ʿAbd al-Malik
6bda1aa840.e: Sulayman sent his brother Maslama ibn ʿAbd al-Malik with a great army against Constantinople.

46a7821428.q: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi said of an imam flogged in the trial (the Mihna): “Had he been among the Children of Israel, he would have become a legend.” Who was he?
46a7821428.e: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi said it of Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal when he was flogged in the trial over the claim that the Qurʾan is created.

a9fec21e71.q: Which student of al-Shafiʿi died in al-Wathiq's prison, weighed down with iron chains, during the Mihna?
a9fec21e71.e: Al-Buwayti died in al-Wathiq's prison in chains, standing firm through the trial.

0fbb798315.q: In which year did Harun al-Rashid receive the pledge as caliph?
0fbb798315.e: Al-Rashid received the pledge on the night his brother al-Hadi died, in Rabiʿ al-Awwal 170 AH.

c1fca36d8c.q: Who was the mother of Caliph Muhammad al-Amin, son of Harun al-Rashid?
c1fca36d8c.e: Al-Amin's mother was Zubayda bint Jaʿfar, granddaughter of Abu Jaʿfar al-Mansur.

a0a149272c.q: Someone said: “Among the beauties of Islam are Friday in Baghdad, Tarawih in Makkah, and the day of ʿEid in …”?
a0a149272c.e: Al-Khatib quoted this saying in praise of Baghdad: Friday in Baghdad, Tarawih in Makkah, and ʿEid in Tarsus.

faee6b0fd5.q: Which mosque did Jawhar the commander complete in Cairo, with the first sermon given in it in 361 AH?
c: The Mosque of ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs
faee6b0fd5.e: Jawhar finished building al-Azhar Mosque, and the sermon was given in it in 361 AH.

4504ec0031.q: Which school was begun in Baghdad in Dhu al-Hijjah 457 AH?
4504ec0031.e: Building of the Nizamiyya school in Baghdad began in 457 AH.

3c7bfaaf60.q: In which land was the battle Ibn Kathir calls “the Battle of al-Zallaqa” in 591 AH?
3c7bfaaf60.e: The battle was in al-Andalus, north of Cordoba, and Allah gave the Muslims victory.

bd5560546f.q: What was the kunya (teknonym) of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
bd5560546f.e: The kunya of the Prophet ﷺ was Abu al-Qasim.

dc9d9f3f91.q: What was the name of the father of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
dc9d9f3f91.e: The father of the Prophet ﷺ was named ʿAbd Allah.

c4c11eaf3c.q: Which grandfather of the Prophet ﷺ cared for him after his mother died?
c4c11eaf3c.e: His grandfather ʿAbd al-Muttalib cared for him after his mother died.

fe3e3b451c.q: From which clan of Quraysh did Allah choose the Prophet ﷺ?
fe3e3b451c.e: The Prophet ﷺ was of Banu Hashim of Quraysh.

6e21918d32.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when he married Khadija ﵂?
6e21918d32.e: The Prophet ﷺ married Khadija when he was twenty-five.

b2fb85a6c7.q: Who set the Black Stone in its place when Quraysh rebuilt the Kaʿba?
b2fb85a6c7.e: The Prophet ﷺ set the Black Stone in its place.

98c6476cb0.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when revelation came to him?
98c6476cb0.e: Revelation came to the Prophet ﷺ when he was forty.

e646ff20d3.q: In which month did revelation begin to come to the Prophet ﷺ?
e646ff20d3.e: Revelation began to come to the Prophet ﷺ in the month of Ramadan.

08a883cbf4.q: What is the name of the angel who brought the Qurʾan down to the Prophet ﷺ?
08a883cbf4.e: Jibril, peace be upon him, brought the Qurʾan down to the Prophet ﷺ.

6fa190fa9d.q: What was the title of the king of Abyssinia who sheltered and honoured the Muslim emigrants?
6fa190fa9d.e: The Negus, king of Abyssinia, sheltered and honoured the Muslims.

9ea2925230.q: Which uncle of the Prophet ﷺ walked behind him telling people, “Do not listen to him”?
9ea2925230.e: Abu Lahab, the Prophet's uncle ﷺ, called him a liar in front of people.

0a1ccded7c.q: The Prophet ﷺ was taken by night from the Sacred Mosque to where?
0a1ccded7c.e: The Prophet ﷺ was taken by night from the Sacred Mosque to Jerusalem.

ef3e67153c.q: To which city did the Prophet ﷺ permit the Muslims to emigrate from Makkah?
ef3e67153c.e: The Muslims emigrated from Makkah to Madinah.

b2ba80156d.q: Which horseman chased the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr during the Hijra, until his horse's forelegs sank into the ground?
b2ba80156d.e: Suraqa ibn Malik chased them and his horse's forelegs sank into the ground.

86b189c241.q: In whose house did the Prophet ﷺ stay when he arrived in Madinah?
86b189c241.e: The Prophet ﷺ stayed in the house of Abu Ayyub ﵁.

7d973ad2b3.q: Which mosque did the Prophet ﷺ found while staying in Quba?
7d973ad2b3.e: The Prophet ﷺ founded the Mosque of Quba.

5cda8ead67.q: The qibla was changed from Jerusalem to where?
5cda8ead67.e: The qibla was changed from Jerusalem to the Kaʿba.

938fb0cc01.q: Who killed Hamza, the uncle of the Prophet ﷺ?
938fb0cc01.e: Wahshi killed Hamza, the uncle of the Prophet ﷺ.

2b46e7fa2e.q: Which of the Prophet's children ﷺ lived on after his death?
2b46e7fa2e.e: All the Prophet's children ﷺ died before him except Fatima ﵂.

e74c8d6e29.q: Who was the eldest child of the Prophet ﷺ, after whom he was called “Abu …”?
e74c8d6e29.e: Al-Qasim was the eldest child of the Prophet ﷺ, and he was called Abu al-Qasim after him.

e391ddce51.q: Hafsa, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, was the daughter of whom?
e391ddce51.e: Hafsa ﵂ was the daughter of ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab.

9ad1af71b3.q: ʿAʾisha, Mother of the Believers ﵂, was the daughter of whom?
9ad1af71b3.e: ʿAʾisha ﵂ was the daughter of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq.

05f9d0877f.q: Who led the people in prayer during the Prophet's ﷺ final illness?
05f9d0877f.e: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq led the people in prayer during the Prophet's ﷺ illness.

b2a06b11e6.q: On which day of the week did the Prophet ﷺ pass away?
b2a06b11e6.e: The Prophet ﷺ passed away on a Monday.

d2ae481fe9.q: According to the sound view, how old was the Prophet ﷺ when he passed away?
d2ae481fe9.e: The Prophet ﷺ passed away at sixty-three, according to the sound view.

e2a335ced1.q: Who was the first caliph the Muslims pledged allegiance to after the Prophet ﷺ died?
e2a335ced1.e: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was the first caliph the Muslims pledged allegiance to.

fcd94fa283.q: What was the name of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁?
fcd94fa283.e: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's name was ʿAbd Allah.

d76acf8846.q: Why was Abu Bakr ﵁ called al-Siddiq (the Truthful Believer)?
c: Because he hastened to believe the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Because he was the oldest of the Companions
Because he was the richest man in Quraysh
Because he was the first to call the adhan
d76acf8846.e: He was called al-Siddiq because he hastened to believe the Prophet ﷺ.

ae818a422f.q: Whom did Abu Bakr ﵁ appoint to lead the Muslims after him?
ae818a422f.e: Abu Bakr appointed ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab to succeed him.

f40b1cc979.q: What was the title of ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab ﵁?
f40b1cc979.e: ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab's title was al-Faruq (the one who distinguishes truth from falsehood).

df2f05b1e7.q: What was the name of the man who stabbed ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab ﵁ as he went out to the prayer?

a77f4033e7.q: Whom did the people pledge allegiance to as caliph after ʿUmar ﵁ was buried?
a77f4033e7.e: The people pledged allegiance to ʿUthman as caliph after ʿUmar was buried.

f27f869b71.q: Who received the pledge as caliph after ʿUthman ﵁ was killed?
f27f869b71.e: ʿAli received the pledge as caliph after ʿUthman ﵁ was killed.

86fbe1619f.q: Who gave ʿAli ibn Abi Talib ﵁ the name Abu Turab?
86fbe1619f.e: The Prophet ﷺ is the one who called ʿAli Abu Turab.

9095bb6e5f.q: Which daughter of the Prophet ﷺ was the wife of ʿAli ibn Abi Talib ﵁?
9095bb6e5f.e: ʿAli ﵁ married Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ.

f145a832d4.q: What was the name of the Prophet's mother ﷺ?
f145a832d4.e: The Prophet's mother ﷺ was Amina bint Wahb of Banu Zuhra.

3db4ea3fc5.q: Who nursed the Prophet ﷺ among Banu Saʿd?
3db4ea3fc5.e: Halima al-Saʿdiyya nursed him ﷺ in the land of Banu Saʿd.

f04d91e210.q: On which day of the week was the Prophet ﷺ born?
f04d91e210.e: The Prophet ﷺ was born on a Monday.

d9f2beb7e4.q: According to the sound view, in which year was the Prophet ﷺ born?
d9f2beb7e4.e: The sound view is that he ﷺ was born in the Year of the Elephant.

630368bbbf.q: In which cave did revelation first come to the Prophet ﷺ?
630368bbbf.e: Revelation first came while the Prophet ﷺ was in the Cave of Hiraʾ.

71531ed0de.q: What were the first words the angel recited to the Prophet ﷺ in the Cave of Hiraʾ?
c: “Read in the name of your Lord who created”
“All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds”
71531ed0de.e: The angel said to him: “Read in the name of your Lord who created.” (meaning)

0a40057aca.q: Who cared for the Prophet ﷺ after his grandfather ʿAbd al-Muttalib died?
0a40057aca.e: After ʿAbd al-Muttalib died, his uncle Abu Talib cared for him.

7e839185c0.q: By what title did his people know the Prophet ﷺ before his mission?
7e839185c0.e: He ﷺ was known among his people as al-Amin for his honesty and trustworthiness.

9464f5ccf4.q: To which land did Allah permit the Muslims to emigrate when persecution in Makkah grew severe?
9464f5ccf4.e: When the hardship grew severe, the Muslims emigrated to the land of Abyssinia.

a11b206abe.q: Which mount did the Prophet ﷺ ride on the Night Journey (al-Israʾ)?
a11b206abe.e: The Prophet ﷺ rode al-Buraq from the Sacred Mosque to Jerusalem.

3c7dcaa720.q: In which cave did the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr ﵁ hide during the Hijra?
3c7dcaa720.e: The Prophet ﷺ and his companion hid in the Cave of Thawr.

64da063950.q: Who carried food to the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr ﵁ in the cave?
c: Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah
64da063950.e: Asmaʾ bint Abi Bakr carried provisions to them in the cave.

53a198ee12.q: Who stayed behind in Makkah after the Hijra to return the trusts left with the Prophet ﷺ?
53a198ee12.e: ʿAli ﵁ stayed in Makkah until he had returned the trusts, then joined the Prophet ﷺ.

4e34b4153a.q: Which Companion advised digging the trench?
4e34b4153a.e: The trench was dug on the advice of Salman al-Farisi ﵁.

c055d5df9b.q: What was the name of the monk who foretold the Prophet ﷺ on his journey to Syria with his uncle?
c055d5df9b.e: The monk Bahira foretold him on his journey with his uncle to Syria.

3330baa662.q: Where did Amina, the Prophet's mother ﷺ, die?
3330baa662.e: His mother ﷺ died at al-Abwaʾ on the way back from Madinah to Makkah.

591c469c20.q: Who killed Sumayya, the mother of ʿAmmar ﵂?
591c469c20.e: Abu Jahl, ʿAmr ibn Hisham, killed her while she was being tortured with her husband and son.

bddaf9f620.q: Which daughter of the Prophet ﷺ emigrated with her husband ʿUthman ibn ʿAffan ﵁ to Abyssinia?
bddaf9f620.e: ʿUthman ﵁ went to Abyssinia with his wife Ruqayya, daughter of the Prophet ﷺ.

46e2a51ef2.q: Which sura did Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib ﵁ recite to the Negus?
46e2a51ef2.e: Jaʿfar recited to the Negus the sura beginning Kaf-Ha-Ya-ʿAyn-Sad, which is Surat Maryam.

7a086e742c.q: What did Allah send upon the boycott document so that it ate everything in it except the mention of Allah?
7a086e742c.e: Termites ate the whole document except the mention of Allah the Exalted.

37ea7f54f3.q: Under whose protection did the Prophet ﷺ enter Makkah after returning from Taʾif?
37ea7f54f3.e: He ﷺ returned from Taʾif and entered Makkah under the protection of al-Mutʿim ibn ʿAdi.

01c781ea4a.q: What did Allah make obligatory for the Prophet ﷺ on the night of al-Israʾ and al-Miʿraj?
01c781ea4a.e: The prayers were made obligatory on the night of al-Miʿraj.

0fd617e1b5.q: Who said on the day of Badr, “If you led us into the sea, we would plunge into it with you”?
0fd617e1b5.e: Saʿd ibn Muʿadh ﵁ said it, showing the Ansar's readiness to fight.

d2b9a24e48.q: Who finished off Abu Jahl on the day of Badr and cut off his head?
d2b9a24e48.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn Masʿud finished him off, cut off his head and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ.

66ee5831d0.q: Which sura did Allah reveal about the Battle of Badr?
66ee5831d0.e: Surat al-Anfal was revealed about the Battle of Badr.

1394c72f0d.q: Who dueled ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd Wudd on the day of the Trench and killed him?
1394c72f0d.e: ʿAli ﵁ dueled ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd Wudd and killed him.
